messages:
alvaro: Hey team — trying to find the EU model-health and service-overview tiles for the inference cluster (eu-west-1). The grafana links in the docs give me a 403. Anyone know the current shortlinks or which SSO group I should be in? Also want a Loki query to pull recent model-server stderr for model-rtr-v2.

sasha: Which tile exactly — service-overview or model-health?

alvaro: model-health + the service-overview that shows p95 token-latency and error-rate. Clicking the dashboard returns 403. I think my Okta groups changed.

maya: We locked down EU dashboards last week. The dashboards live behind the redwood-obsv-eu SSO group. Ops needs to add you. pinging @ben to help.

ben: @alvaro I can add you. Can you confirm your Okta email? Also you only need viewer access, right?

alvaro: yep viewer is fine. email is alvaro@redwood.com

ben: added alvaro@redwood.com to redwood-obsv-eu — should propagate in ~5m. If you still see 403, send a screenshot/response.

alvaro: thanks — while I wait, can someone paste a short Loki query to get the last 30m of stderr for model-rtr-v2? Looking for tokenization WARNs.

sasha: try this (quick copy):

```loki
{app="model-server"} |= "model-rtr-v2" |~ "WARN|ERROR" | line_format "{{.timestamp}} {{.level}} {{.message}}"
```

then filter further with `|= "token"` or `| duration(30m)` in the UI time picker.

maya: FYI the runbook has the prebuilt queries + dashboard shortlink: <https://internal.redwood/grafana/runbooks/model-health>
Shortlink: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd1234/model-health-eu

ops-bot: Access change (audit): User alvaro@redwood.com added to group redwood-obsv-eu by ben (5m ago)

alvaro: Confirmed I can open the dashboard now — able to view the p95 graphs. Quick follow-up: our p95 latency alert fires during scheduled scaling bursts (autoscale warmups). Is that expected noise? Where do we propose tuning?

ben: For alert tuning, open a ticket in #eng-oncall or an issue in infra-alerts. Short-term we either mute alerts during known scale windows or add a suppression tied to autoscaler events. Medium-term adjust thresholds or use a baseline correction.

sasha: immediate mitigation: add a temporary mute in alertmanager for the autoscaler job IDs during the known burst window. I can propose a rule.

alvaro: I'll create a ticket in eng-oncall with dashboard link + sample logs. Thanks. :raised_hands:

infra-bot: Created ticket ENGON-472 — "Alert tuning: p95 spikes during autoscale". Assigned to sasha.

sasha: got it, I'll triage tomorrow and propose a change.

ben: closing loop — alvaro access verified and grp membership confirmed. :white_check_mark:
